chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
When a man performs Istimta' with the Umrah, he has fulfilled what was upon him from the obligatory Umrah.

key_terms.اسْتَمْتَعَ: Istimta' (to enjoy/perform the ritual act of fulfilling obligation)

ai.seo_question: Does performing Istimta' with Umrah fulfill the obligatory Umrah duty?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that a single performance of Umrah fulfills the obligatory duty, addressing the scholarly debate on whether Umrah is a one-time obligation or recurring. This ruling is foundational in Shia fiqh for determining the minimum requirement for this pilgrimage, distinguishing it from the recommended, repeated nature of Hajj al-Tamattu'.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When a man performs Tumatto with the Umra, so he has fulfilled whatever was upon him, from the Obligatory Umra’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu `Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
if one performs al-‘Umrah in al-Tamattu £ form, he has completed the obligatory acts of an obligatory al- £ Umrah.”
